name: structural-build-staging-copy-dir-reconciliation
body: `solution.component.structural-build-staging` is implemented-by `rust.build_script_build.main` and `rust.build_script_build.build_frontends`. `rust.build_script_build.copy_dir` is a recursive directory copier that stages the Java class directory and the TypeScript `node_modules`; every single-binary frontend stages with `std::fs::copy` in `rust.build_script_build.main` — `cppfrontend`, `gofrontend`, `rustfrontend`, `pyfrontend`, the TypeScript `scanner.mjs`, and `csharpfrontend`.
